summary: Iter39 Tier 1 gap-plug + Tier 2 quick wins fully verified end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest cases pass: briefings list returns is_read/read_via/read_at; mark-read upserts (manual + scroll, idempotent, 404 on unknown); objective-check eligibility flips to true after backdating seeded_metadata.generated_at >24h, persists answer (yes/partial/no with note), skip flips dismissed=true, invalid answer rejected with 422. UI smoke (Bramuel real account on Tuli Financial Group NED ctx) confirms: Monitor — green sparkline gone, 'How is this calculated?' methodology trigger renders popover on hover with copy 'The score is machine-generated. AKKI benchmarks reported performance against the strategic document…'; Lens — apply button removed from picker row, lens-apply-row sits below lens-input-card in DOM; Cycle '3·Send checklists' — cycle-deadline-input has type='date' and accepts 2026-04-30; Cycle '5·Consolidate & send up' — compose-report-tile renders with status 'No reportees set up yet. Compose a freeform report or seed your team in 1 · Your team.' and the Compose button is inside the tile; Briefings — '1 unread' rail count, clicking the unread row reveals the Mark-as-read button, click flips it to briefing-read-badge, page reload persists the read state. Tutorial copy + ObjectiveCheck card correctly hidden on Bramuel's real (non-sandbox) home; their visibility is gated on sandbox/seeded metadata which the backend lifecycle test confirms works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: briefings.py mark-read endpoint correctly uses upsert with $setOnInsert for first_read_at while $set refreshes read_at + read_via — clean idempotent pattern; 404 on unknown briefing or wrong context preserved.

sandbox.py _meta_branch helper neatly switches between sandbox_metadata and seeded_metadata based on ctx.type — single source of truth for both paths; lifecycle (eligible→answered→non-eligible) and skip→dismissed both persist cleanly.
Briefings.jsx scroll-depth handler triggers /mark-read with via='scroll' — backend persists this distinct read_via channel so analytics can later differentiate intentional vs passive reads.

Cycle.jsx YYYY-MM-DD → 'DD Month YYYY' conversion uses Date constructor on date-only string which can drift in non-UTC timezones (Date.UTC parsing); consider parsing Y-M-D explicitly to avoid off-by-one for users near date-line. Not blocking.
ObjectiveCheck.jsx skip path posts answer:'skip' to backend (not just hides locally) — correctly idempotent and backend flips dismissed:true so it never re-surfaces.
